description: This source file defines a custom batching logger class for the litellm project, providing functionality to batch log messages and periodically flush them. It extends the CustomLogger class and manages an in-memory log queue with configurable batch size and flush interval.

classes.name: CustomBatchLogger
classes.description: A logger class that handles batching of log messages, allowing logs to be stored in memory and flushed periodically to an external destination.
